notes.title: 【DEMO Version Updated】B Route Chapter 7 Update Announcement
notes.notes: [p]Hello! I'm Moka~ This time, I uploaded B7 alone! Because it occupies a more important position in the main line. I think playing it earlier can have a positive effect on understanding the story, especially the D-line. The special feature of this chapter is that it is all about the past, so there are few branches. Instead, it elaborates on the concept conflicts, childhood and family changes of A and B. The subsequent B89 chapter will be made and live in two months! (It may be delayed if there is an accident)[/p][p]In addition, I plan to start some fund-raising activities after the launch of B789 to prepare for the Finished version. I haven't made a detailed plan yet! But it could be subscription extras (like aifadian or Patreon to share the progress of the game and other small comics, illustrations, etc.), physical crowdfunding, or pre-sale of the official version of the redemption code, which would you prefer? Please tell me what you think![/p][p][/p][p][b]The main contents of the new version are as follows:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed some bugs, CG[/p][/*][*][p]Updated some character portraits and facial expressions[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Archive Directory" button in the Settings to facilitate archive referral between different versions[/p][/*][*][p]5 new CGs[/p][/*][*][p]8 new SCs[/p][/*][*][p]13k words for Bryant's main route[/p][/*][*][p]3 new character arts[/p][/*][/list][quote][p]It's been over 80 days since the last update, but I've actually been modifying the script for B789! I always felt dissatisfied, so I changed it many times, and the final number of words swelled to sixty-five thousand...... Much longer than D789!! Unfortunately, time has become scattered after school starts, and it is a very difficult task for me to load all these new content into the game... Please understand that the production cycle may become longer... ![/p][/quote]

notes.title: 【DEMO Version Updated】D Route Chapter 789 Update Announcement

Hope you all enjoy the new storyline![/p][p][b]The main contents of the new version are as follows:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Removed the text option color-changing feature that caused bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Updated some character portraits and facial expressions[/p][/*][*][p]13 new CGs[/p][/*][*][p]23 new SCs[/p][/*][*][p]28k words for Deacon's main route[/p][/*][*][p]2 new character arts[/p][/*][*][p]5 endings and belonging achievements[/p][/*][/list][quote][p]I've spent a lot of time fixing bugs and adjusting translations, but due to the large volume of text and time constraints, there may still be some issues in this version. If you encounter any bugs, please leave a comment with a screenshot in the comments section~ Thanks(*^▽^*)[/p][/quote][p]Please note that this update includes a significant amount of content related to mental illness and psychological descriptions. If you feel uncomfortable while playing, please stop immediately and take a break![/p]

notes.title: Version 0.55 Update - UI Refinement and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello! I'm Moka. Over the past two months, while preparing for exams, I've received numerous repos and lots of valuable suggestions. So, this version has no content updates but focuses on functional tweaks based on feedbacks!

The main contents of the new version are as follows:
1. Fixed some typos and bugs.
2. Adjusted a few CGs.
3. Added a quick button to hide the dialogue box—just click the shortcut below it to toggle UI visibility!
4. Added more tips to the prologue to help new players get started quickly.
5. Unified and updated the UI style.
6. Overhauled the save screen—now showing chapter and fragment counts!
7. Changed the color of read options, which can be disabled in settings.
8. Redesigned the ending screen—HEs, BEs, and NEs are now categorized, with CGs and flashbacks matched accordingly.

Thanks to Edda, 球球, PAN, 不冉 for all of those suggestions, and to all my supporters!
My exams end mid-April, and I'll resume working on the game then.
This chapter has lots of experimental elements, new content to draw, and complex emotional scenes. Progress might be slow!! Patience please TT

notes.title: Demo Version Update Notice + Promotional PV Released
notes.notes:
The 0.5.3 version has been released, mainly featuring updates to some CGs and refinements of the six new ending CGs added in version 0.5.2.

Additionally, a promotional video (PV) for the demo version has been uploaded to Bilibili.com. You can watch it and join the discussion in the comments section below the video. Here’s the link:
https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1o8Are5EJK/

If you enjoy the game, please consider leaving a rating or comment on the itch.io page for "Fried Chicken Wings Cause Love Fire":
https://mokamwww.itch.io/fried-chicken-wings

Updates on this platform might be faster due to the convenience of Steam updates. School data charges are quite expensive!!!
For players aiming to collect all-endings, you can find a walkthrough by right-clicking the game icon and opening the local path.

By the way, all the music used in the game is in the game/audio folder, and the borrowing list is in the README.
Thanks to all the creaters who make their music commercially available for free (*^▽^*) especially the source of 90% of the music—— nojisuma-san!!
